title: Each to Their Own Story
overview: Boxxo and Kikoyu celebrate birthdays, and the party ventures to the Dog Mountain stratum.

title: The Clam and the Vending Machine
overview: Boxxo's crew reach Pity's island, where old and new enemies await them.

title: A Stay in Enemy Territory
overview: Boxxo and Pity seek a way to escape from the Netherlord's base.

title: The Troubles Will Continue Forever
overview: The situation gets hairy at the Dog Mountain stratum, and Boxxo attempts to help Gorth with his love life.

title: Another Uproar
overview: Plans to tackle the Everlasting stratum are put on hold when a large horde of monsters attacks the village.

title: Yesterday's Enemies Are Today's...
overview: The path through the Everlasting stratum is long, dark, and monotonous, but that doesn't rule out surprises.

title: The Beginning of the End
overview: Boxxo and friends learn some unexpected dungeon lore in the innermost depths of the Everlasting stratum.

title: As an Apprentice
overview: With the dungeon collapsed and Boxxo gone, the rest of the heroes split up to go salvage the situation.

title: The Thumb General
overview: Boxxo returns, but his group has a fight on their hands before they can catch up to everyone else.

title: I Am a Field without Equal
overview: Field goes to parley with the Demon Lord, and plans for countering the Netherlord begin to take shape.

title: To the Final Showdown
overview: Boxxo and Lammis face betrayal below as the Netherlord ignites the final battle.

title: Dreamworld
overview: Boxxo has to use every trick in the book to fight the mighty Netherlord. Can he and Lammis save the world?
